fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.architectures

Interface ArchitectureI

  • All Superinterfaces:
    java.io.Serializable
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    Architecture, RTArchitecture

    public interface ArchitectureI
extends java.io.Serializable
    The interface ModelArchitectureI defines the signatures of methods to be handled by a DEVS simulation architecture implementation.

      • isChildModelOf

        boolean isChildModelOf(java.lang.String childURI,
                       java.lang.String parentURI)
                throws java.lang.Exception
        return true if the model childURI is a child of the model parentURI in the architecture.

        Contract

         pre     childURI != null && !childURI.isEmpty()
 pre     parentURI != null && !parentURI.isEmpty()
 pre     isModel(childURI) && isCoupledModel(parentURI)
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Parameters:
        childURI - URI of the possible child model.
        parentURI - URI of the possible parent model.
        Returns:
        true if the model childURI is a child of the model parentURI
        Throws:
        java.lang.Exception - if one of the URI does not exist in the architecture.

      • addAtomicModelAsRoot

        void addAtomicModelAsRoot(java.lang.String modelURI,
                          AtomicModelDescriptor descriptor)
        add an atomic model to the architecture as its root model.

        Contract

         pre     modelURI != null && !modelURI.isEmpty()
 pre     !isModel(modelURI)
 pre     getAllModels().size() == 0
 pre     descriptor != null && descriptor.modelURI.equals(modelURI)
 post    isAtomicModel(modelURI)
 post    isRootModel(modelURI)
 post    isMonoModel()
 post    isComplete()
        Parameters:
        modelURI - URI of the new model.
        descriptor - descriptor of the added model.

      • addCoupledModelAsRoot

        void addCoupledModelAsRoot(java.lang.String modelURI,
                           CoupledModelDescriptor descriptor)
        add a coupled model to the architecture as its root model.

         pre     modelURI != null && !modelURI.isEmpty()
 pre     !isModel(modelURI)
 pre     getRootModel() == null
 pre     descriptor != null && descriptor.modelURI.equals(modelURI)
 post    isCoupledModel(modelURI)
 post    !isMonoModel()
 post    isRootModel(modelURI)
        Parameters:
        modelURI - URI of the model to be added.
        descriptor - descriptor of the added model.

      • isComplete

        boolean isComplete()
        return true if the model architecture can be interpreted as complete i.e., all models mentioned as submodels, sources or sinks of events have descriptors defined in this model architecture.

        Detecting that an architecture is complete is complex. A possibility would be to have a specific method to be called to inform that the architecture is complete, but in practice, if the architecture is constructed by gathering model descriptions from several parallel or distributed processes, it would be extremely difficult (and probably repetitive in terms of coding) to check that all models have been added to the architecture. Hence, the basic idea of the test is to check that the root model has been defined and that no models mention the URI of another model that has not been added yet.

        Contract

         pre     true        // no precondition.
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Returns:
        true if the model architecture can be interpreted as complete.
